name: Memory Jar Attic
description: A cozy attic filled with glowing glass jars, each containing a tiny luminous scene of a remembered moment.
prompt: A single emotional attic scene filled with shelves of glowing glass jars, each jar containing a tiny luminous memory: a birthday candle, a seaside sunset, a snowy window, a dancing couple. Dust motes float in warm beams of light, an old armchair and knit blanket below. Nostalgic, intimate, painterly, no text, no logos, no watermarks.
caption: If you could keep one memory in a jar, which moment would glow brightest?
